description.zh:
业务隔离ID，用于同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据隔离，支持英文大小写字母、数字。

例如，您在A地区和B地区，均有人脸识别业务，那么可设置不同的业务隔离ID，区分A、B地区的人脸识别业务。

><notice>
请妥善保存业务隔离ID值，以便后续调用此业务隔离区其它接口时使用。
></notice>
description.en:
The business isolation ID, which is used for data isolation between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account. The value can contain uppercase and lowercase letters and digits.

For example, if you have face recognition services in both Region A and Region B, you can set different business isolation IDs to distinguish between the face recognition services in Region A and Region B.

><notice>
Save the business isolation ID for use when you call other operations in this isolation scope.
></notice>.

description.zh: 用户组名称，请自定义参数值，长度不超过128个字符。
description.en: The name of the user group. Specify a custom value. The name can be up to 128 characters in length.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明

- 单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为100。

    > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。

- 调用该接口后，系统会返回用户组的ID（**UserGroupId**），建议保存该值到本地，以便后续调用其它接口时使用。
descriptions.en:
## Operation description

- The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) per Alibaba Cloud account for invoking this operation is 100.

    > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

- After you invoke this operation, the system returns the user group ID (**UserGroupId**). Save this value locally for use when you invoke other operations.
